description: Get daily net ETF flow history for a single crypto asset over the last 30 days. Returns a time series of net USD millions per day (positive = inflow, negative = outflow). Figures are asset-level totals; the per-fund breakdown (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA and others) is returned by get_fund_flows.

asset.description: Asset to fetch: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_asset_flows
title: Crypto ETF Flow History
